#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <list>
#include <deque>
#include <queue>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <stack>
#include <algorithm>  // sort, reverse, max, min, swap
using namespace std;

int main() {
    // ============================================================
    // 1. vector 动态数组
    // ============================================================
    cout << "========== vector ==========" << endl;
    vector<int> v = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};

    // 添加元素
    v.push_back(6);                 // 尾部插入
    v.insert(v.begin(), 0);         // 在开头插入

    // 访问元素
    cout << "第一个元素: " << v.front() << endl;
    cout << "最后一个元素: " << v.back() << endl;
    cout << "下标访问: " << v[2] << endl;
    cout << "安全访问: " << v.at(2) << endl;

    // 容量操作
    cout << "大小: " << v.size() << endl;
    cout << "容量: " << v.capacity() << endl;

    // 遍历
    for (int num : v) {
        cout << num << " ";
    }
    cout << endl;

    // 删除元素
    v.pop_back();                    // 删除最后一个
    v.erase(v.begin() + 2);          // 删除第三个元素
    v.clear();                       // 清空所有元素

    // --- 二维 vector ---
    vector<vector<int>> vv;          // 空的二维数组
    vector<vector<int>> vv2(3, vector<int>(4, 0));  // 3行4列，全部初始化为0

    // 动态构建二维数组
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        vector<int> row;
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            row.push_back(i * 4 + j);
        }
        vv.push_back(row);
    }

    // 遍历二维数组
    cout << "二维vector:" << endl;
    for (int i = 0; i < vv.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < vv[i].size(); j++) {
            cout << vv[i][j] << " ";
        }
        cout << endl;
    }

    // --- 三维 vector ---
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> vvv;  // 空的二维数组
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> vvv2(2, vector<vector<int>>(3, vector<int>(4, 0)));  // 2层 x 3行 x 4列

    // 动态构建三维数组
    for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
        vector<vector<int>> layer;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            vector<int> row;
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                row.push_back(k * 100 + i * 10 + j);
            }
            layer.push_back(row);
        }
        vvv.push_back(layer);
    }

    // 遍历三维数组
    cout << "三维vector:" << endl;
    for (int k = 0; k < vvv.size(); k++) {
        cout << "第" << k << "层:" << endl;
        for (int i = 0; i < vvv[k].size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < vvv[k][i].size(); j++) {
                cout << vvv[k][i][j] << " ";
            }
            cout << endl;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 2. list 双向链表
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== list ==========" << endl;
    list<int> lst = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};

    // 两端操作
    lst.push_front(0);               // 头部插入
    lst.push_back(6);                // 尾部插入
    lst.pop_front();                 // 头部删除
    lst.pop_back();                  // 尾部删除

    // 任意位置插入（使用迭代器）
    auto lit = lst.begin();
    advance(lit, 3);                 // 移动到第4个位置
    lst.insert(lit, 99);

    // 遍历
    for (int num : lst) {
        cout << num << " ";
    }
    cout << endl;

    // list 专用操作
    lst.sort();                      // 排序
    lst.unique();                    // 去重（需先排序）
    lst.reverse();                   // 反转
    lst.remove(2);                   // 删除所有值为2的元素

    // ============================================================
    // 3. deque 双端队列
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== deque ==========" << endl;
    deque<int> dq = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};

    // 两端操作
    dq.push_front(0);                // 头部插入
    dq.push_back(6);                 // 尾部插入
    dq.pop_front();                  // 头部删除
    dq.pop_back();                   // 尾部删除

    // 随机访问（list不支持，deque支持）
    cout << "第三个元素: " << dq[2] << endl;
    cout << "安全访问: " << dq.at(2) << endl;

    // ============================================================
    // 4. set 集合（自动排序、去重）
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== set ==========" << endl;
    set<int> s2 = {5, 3, 1, 4, 2, 3};  // 重复的3只会保留一个

    // 自动排序输出
    cout << "set内容（自动排序+去重）: ";
    for (int num : s2) {
        cout << num << " ";          // 输出: 1 2 3 4 5
    }
    cout << endl;

    // 插入
    s2.insert(6);
    s2.insert(6);                    // 重复插入无效

    // 查找
    auto sit = s2.find(3);
    if (sit != s2.end()) {
        cout << "找到元素: " << *sit << endl;
    }

    // 计数（set中只有0或1）
    cout << "元素3出现次数: " << s2.count(3) << endl;

    // 删除
    s2.erase(2);                     // 删除值为2的元素
    s2.erase(s2.begin());            // 删除第一个元素

    // ============================================================
    // 5. map 键值对映射（自动按键排序）
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== map ==========" << endl;
    map<string, int> mp;

    // 插入方式1：使用 pair
    mp.insert(pair<string, int>("apple", 10));
    // 插入方式2：使用 make_pair
    mp.insert(make_pair("banana", 20));
    // 插入方式3：使用下标（最简洁）
    mp["orange"] = 30;
    // 插入方式4：使用 emplace（高效，C++11）
    mp.emplace("grape", 40);

    // 查找
    auto mit = mp.find("banana");
    if (mit != mp.end()) {
        cout << "banana的值: " << mit->second << endl;
    }

    // 访问（不存在的key会自动插入默认值，慎用）
    cout << "apple的值: " << mp["apple"] << endl;
    cout << "orange的值: " << mp.at("orange") << endl;  // 安全访问

    // 计数
    cout << "banana是否存在: " << mp.count("banana") << endl;
    cout << "pear是否存在: " << mp.count("pear") << endl;

    // 遍历（自动按key排序）
    cout << "map内容（按键排序）:" << endl;
    for (const auto& p : mp) {
        cout << "  " << p.first << " -> " << p.second << endl;
    }

    // 删除
    mp.erase("grape");

    // 大小
    cout << "map大小: " << mp.size() << endl;

    // ============================================================
    // 6. stack 栈（后进先出 LIFO）
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== stack ==========" << endl;
    stack<int> stk;

    stk.push(1);                     // 入栈
    stk.push(2);
    stk.push(3);

    cout << "栈顶: " << stk.top() << endl;    // 3
    cout << "大小: " << stk.size() << endl;

    stk.pop();                       // 出栈（移除栈顶3）
    cout << "pop后栈顶: " << stk.top() << endl; // 2
    cout << "是否为空: " << stk.empty() << endl;

    // 遍历栈（用临时副本）
    cout << "栈内容（从顶到底）: ";
    stack<int> tmp = stk;            // 拷贝一份
    while (!tmp.empty()) {
        cout << tmp.top() << " ";
        tmp.pop();
    }
    cout << endl;

    // ============================================================
    // 7. queue 队列（先进先出 FIFO）
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== queue ==========" << endl;
    queue<int> q;

    q.push(10);                      // 入队
    q.push(20);
    q.push(30);

    cout << "队头: " << q.front() << endl;   // 10
    cout << "队尾: " << q.back() << endl;    // 30
    cout << "大小: " << q.size() << endl;

    q.pop();                         // 出队（移除队头10）
    cout << "pop后队头: " << q.front() << endl; // 20
    cout << "是否为空: " << q.empty() << endl;

    // 遍历队列（用临时副本）
    cout << "队列内容（从头到尾）: ";
    queue<int> tmp_q = q;
    while (!tmp_q.empty()) {
        cout << tmp_q.front() << " ";
        tmp_q.pop();
    }
    cout << endl;

    // ============================================================
    // 8. priority_queue 优先队列（自动排序，默认大顶堆）
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== priority_queue ==========" << endl;

    // 默认：大顶堆（最大元素在队首）
    priority_queue<int> pq;
    pq.push(3);
    pq.push(5);
    pq.push(1);
    pq.push(4);
    pq.push(2);

    cout << "大顶堆 队首（最大值）: " << pq.top() << endl; // 5
    cout << "大小: " << pq.size() << endl;

    cout << "出队顺序（从大到小）: ";
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        cout << pq.top() << " ";     // 5 4 3 2 1
        pq.pop();
    }
    cout << endl;

    // 小顶堆（最小元素在队首）
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<int>> min_pq;
    min_pq.push(3);
    min_pq.push(5);
    min_pq.push(1);
    min_pq.push(4);
    min_pq.push(2);

    cout << "小顶堆 队首（最小值）: " << min_pq.top() << endl; // 1

    cout << "出队顺序（从小到大）: ";
    while (!min_pq.empty()) {
        cout << min_pq.top() << " "; // 1 2 3 4 5
        min_pq.pop();
    }
    cout << endl;

    // 自定义比较：pair的优先队列（按second排序）
    priority_queue<pair<int, int>, vector<pair<int, int>>, greater<pair<int, int>>> pq_pair;
    pq_pair.push({1, 100});
    pq_pair.push({2, 50});
    pq_pair.push({3, 80});
    cout << "pair优先队列 队首（按first最小）: (" << pq_pair.top().first << ", " << pq_pair.top().second << ")" << endl;

    // ============================================================
    // 9. string 字符串
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== string ==========" << endl;
    string str = "Hello";
    string str2 = "World";
    string str3;

    // 拼接
    str3 = str + " " + str2;         // "Hello World"
    str.append(" C++");              // 追加
    cout << "拼接: " << str3 << endl;
    cout << "append后: " << str << endl;

    // 长度
    cout << "长度: " << str.length() << endl;
    cout << "长度: " << str.size() << endl;  // 等价

    // 访问字符
    cout << "下标访问: " << str[0] << endl;
    cout << "安全访问: " << str.at(0) << endl;
    cout << "首字符: " << str.front() << endl;
    cout << "尾字符: " << str.back() << endl;

    // 子串
    string sub = str3.substr(0, 5);  // 从位置0开始取5个字符
    cout << "子串(0,5): " << sub << endl;

    // 查找
    size_t pos = str3.find("World");
    if (pos != string::npos) {
        cout << "找到World，位置: " << pos << endl;
    }

    // 替换
    str3.replace(6, 5, "C++");       // 从位置6开始，替换5个字符
    cout << "替换后: " << str3 << endl;

    // 插入
    str3.insert(0, "Hi, ");          // 在位置0插入
    cout << "插入后: " << str3 << endl;

    // 删除
    str3.erase(0, 4);                // 从位置0开始删除4个字符
    cout << "删除后: " << str3 << endl;

    // 比较
    if (str2 == "World") {
        cout << "str2等于World" << endl;
    }
    int cmp = str.compare(str2);     // 返回0表示相等，<0表示str<str2，>0表示str>str2

    // 判断子串
    if (str3.find("C++") != string::npos) {
        cout << "str3包含C++" << endl;
    }

    // 清空
    str.clear();
    cout << "清空后是否为空: " << str.empty() << endl;

    // 整数转字符串
    int num = 12345;
    string numStr = to_string(num);
    cout << "数字转字符串: " << numStr << endl;

    // 字符串转整数
    string sNum = "67890";
    int n = stoi(sNum);
    cout << "字符串转数字: " << n << endl;

    // ============================================================
    // 10. pair 二元组
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== pair ==========" << endl;

    // 创建方式
    pair<int, string> p1;
    p1.first = 1;
    p1.second = "one";

    pair<int, string> p2(2, "two");                    // 构造函数
    pair<int, string> p3 = make_pair(3, "three");      // make_pair
    auto p4 = pair<int, string>{4, "four"};             // C++11 列表初始化
    auto p5 = make_pair(5, "five");                    // 自动推导类型

    cout << "p1: " << p1.first << ", " << p1.second << endl;
    cout << "p2: " << p2.first << ", " << p2.second << endl;
    cout << "p3: " << p3.first << ", " << p3.second << endl;
    cout << "p4: " << p4.first << ", " << p4.second << endl;
    cout << "p5: " << p5.first << ", " << p5.second << endl;

    // pair 比较（先比较first，再比较second）
    pair<int, int> pa(1, 5);
    pair<int, int> pb(1, 3);
    if (pa > pb) {
        cout << "pa > pb (因为5>3)" << endl;
    } else {
        cout << "pa <= pb" << endl;
    }

    // pair 交换
    pair<int, int> px(10, 20);
    pair<int, int> py(30, 40);
    cout << "交换前: px=(" << px.first << "," << px.second
         << "), py=(" << py.first << "," << py.second << ")" << endl;
    px.swap(py);                     // 成员函数 swap
    swap(px, py);                    // 算法 swap（交换回来）
    cout << "swap后: px=(" << px.first << "," << px.second
         << "), py=(" << py.first << "," << py.second << ")" << endl;

    // ============================================================
    // 11. 迭代器 iterator
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== 迭代器 ==========" << endl;
    vector<int> vec = {10, 20, 30, 40, 50};

    // 正向迭代器
    cout << "正向遍历: ";
    for (vector<int>::iterator it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        cout << *it << " ";
        *it += 1;                    // 通过迭代器修改值
    }
    cout << endl;

    // 反向迭代器
    cout << "反向遍历: ";
    for (vector<int>::reverse_iterator rit = vec.rbegin(); rit != vec.rend(); ++rit) {
        cout << *rit << " ";
    }
    cout << endl;

    // 只读迭代器
    cout << "const迭代器遍历: ";
    for (vector<int>::const_iterator it = vec.cbegin(); it != vec.cend(); ++it) {
        cout << *it << " ";
        // *it += 1;  // 错误：const_iterator不能修改值
    }
    cout << endl;

    // auto 简化
    cout << "auto遍历: ";
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        cout << *it << " ";
    }
    cout << endl;

    // list 迭代器
    cout << "list迭代器遍历: ";
    list<int> l2 = {100, 200, 300};
    for (list<int>::iterator it = l2.begin(); it != l2.end(); ++it) {
        cout << *it << " ";
    }
    cout << endl;

    // map 迭代器
    cout << "map迭代器遍历: ";
    map<int, string> m2;
    m2[1] = "a"; m2[2] = "b"; m2[3] = "c";
    for (map<int, string>::iterator it = m2.begin(); it != m2.end(); ++it) {
        cout << it->first << ":" << it->second << " ";
    }
    cout << endl;

    // ============================================================
    // 12. 算法：sort, reverse, max, min, swap
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== 算法 ==========" << endl;

    // --- sort 排序 ---
    vector<int> arr = {5, 2, 8, 1, 9, 3, 7, 4, 6};

    // 默认升序
    sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
    cout << "默认升序排序: ";
    for (int x : arr) cout << x << " ";
    cout << endl;

    // 降序排序
    sort(arr.begin(), arr.end(), greater<int>());
    cout << "降序排序: ";
    for (int x : arr) cout << x << " ";
    cout << endl;

    // 部分排序（只排序前5个）
    vector<int> arr2 = {5, 2, 8, 1, 9, 3, 7, 4, 6};
    sort(arr2.begin(), arr2.begin() + 5);
    cout << "部分排序（前5个）: ";
    for (int x : arr2) cout << x << " ";
    cout << endl;

    // 自定义排序（按绝对值）
    vector<int> arr3 = {-3, 1, -5, 2, -4};
    sort(arr3.begin(), arr3.end(), [](int a, int b) {
        return abs(a) < abs(b);      // 按绝对值升序
    });
    cout << "按绝对值排序: ";
    for (int x : arr3) cout << x << " ";
    cout << endl;

    // 自定义排序（pair按second排序）
    vector<pair<int, int>> vp = {{1, 50}, {2, 30}, {3, 40}};
    sort(vp.begin(), vp.end(), [](const pair<int, int>& a, const pair<int, int>& b) {
        return a.second < b.second;  // 按second升序
    });
    cout << "pair按second排序: ";
    for (auto& p : vp) cout << "(" << p.first << "," << p.second << ") ";
    cout << endl;

    // sort 对数组排序
    int carr[] = {5, 3, 1, 4, 2};
    int n5 = sizeof(carr) / sizeof(carr[0]);
    sort(carr, carr + n5);
    cout << "C数组排序: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n5; i++) cout << carr[i] << " ";
    cout << endl;

    // --- reverse 反转 ---
    vector<int> rev = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
    reverse(rev.begin(), rev.end());
    cout << "reverse反转: ";
    for (int x : rev) cout << x << " ";  // 5 4 3 2 1
    cout << endl;

    // 部分反转
    reverse(rev.begin() + 1, rev.begin() + 4);
    cout << "部分反转(第2~4个): ";
    for (int x : rev) cout << x << " ";  // 5 2 3 4 1
    cout << endl;

    // reverse 对字符串
    string srev = "Hello";
    reverse(srev.begin(), srev.end());
    cout << "字符串反转: " << srev << endl;  // olleH

    // --- max / min 最值 ---
    int a = 10, b = 20;
    cout << "max(10,20): " << max(a, b) << endl;
    cout << "min(10,20): " << min(a, b) << endl;

    // 三个数取最大/最小（使用初始化列表，C++11）
    cout << "max({1,5,3}): " << max({1, 5, 3}) << endl;
    cout << "min({1,5,3}): " << min({1, 5, 3}) << endl;

    // 容器中的最大/最小元素
    vector<int> mvec = {3, 7, 2, 9, 1, 5};
    auto max_it = max_element(mvec.begin(), mvec.end());
    auto min_it = min_element(mvec.begin(), mvec.end());
    cout << "最大值: " << *max_it << " (位置: " << distance(mvec.begin(), max_it) << ")" << endl;
    cout << "最小值: " << *min_it << " (位置: " << distance(mvec.begin(), min_it) << ")" << endl;

    // 同时取最大最小（效率比分别调用高一倍）
    auto result = minmax_element(mvec.begin(), mvec.end());
    cout << "同时获取最小最大: min=" << *result.first << ", max=" << *result.second << endl;

    // 自定义比较的 max/min
    cout << "按绝对值max(-10,5): " << max(-10, 5, [](int x, int y) { return abs(x) < abs(y); }) << endl;

    // --- swap 交换 ---
    int x = 10, y = 20;
    cout << "交换前: x=" << x << ", y=" << y << endl;
    swap(x, y);                      // 交换两个变量
    cout << "交换后: x=" << x << ", y=" << y << endl;

    // 交换容器元素
    vector<int> v1 = {1, 2, 3};
    vector<int> v2 = {4, 5, 6};
    cout << "容器交换前: v1[0]=" << v1[0] << ", v2[0]=" << v2[0] << endl;
    swap(v1, v2);                    // 交换两个容器（O(1)效率，仅交换内部指针）
    cout << "容器交换后: v1[0]=" << v1[0] << ", v2[0]=" << v2[0] << endl;

    // 交换两个迭代器指向的元素
    auto it1 = v1.begin();
    auto it2 = v1.begin() + 1;
    cout << "iter_swap前: " << *it1 << " " << *it2 << endl;
    iter_swap(it1, it2);
    cout << "iter_swap后: " << *it1 << " " << *it2 << endl;

    // 交换范围（交换两个区间的内容）
    vector<int> range_a = {1, 2, 3, 10, 20, 30};
    cout << "swap_ranges前: ";
    for (int t : range_a) cout << t << " ";
    cout << endl;
    swap_ranges(range_a.begin(), range_a.begin() + 3, range_a.begin() + 3);
    cout << "swap_ranges后: ";
    for (int t : range_a) cout << t << " ";  // 10 20 30 1 2 3
    cout << endl;

    // ============================================================
    // 13. 常用算法补充
    // ============================================================
    cout << "\n========== 其他常用算法 ==========" << endl;

    // fill 填充
    vector<int> fv(5);
    fill(fv.begin(), fv.end(), 42);
    cout << "fill填充42: ";
    for (int t : fv) cout << t << " ";  // 42 42 42 42 42
    cout << endl;

    // count 计数
    vector<int> cv = {1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2};
    cout << "2出现次数: " << count(cv.begin(), cv.end(), 2) << endl;

    // find 查找
    auto fit = find(cv.begin(), cv.end(), 3);
    if (fit != cv.end()) {
        cout << "找到3，位置: " << distance(cv.begin(), fit) << endl;
    }

    // binary_search 二分查找（要求已排序）
    vector<int> bv = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9};
    if (binary_search(bv.begin(), bv.end(), 5)) {
        cout << "二分查找: 找到5" << endl;
    }

    // lower_bound / upper_bound（要求已排序）
    vector<int> lv = {1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 5};
    auto lb = lower_bound(lv.begin(), lv.end(), 2);  // 第一个 >=2 的位置
    auto ub = upper_bound(lv.begin(), lv.end(), 2);  // 第一个 >2 的位置
    cout << "lower_bound(2): " << distance(lv.begin(), lb) << endl;
    cout << "upper_bound(2): " << distance(lv.begin(), ub) << endl;
    cout << "2的个数（通过bound）: " << ub - lb << endl;

    // unique 去重（需先排序，配合erase真正删除）
    vector<int> uv = {1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5};
    auto last = unique(uv.begin(), uv.end());
    uv.erase(last, uv.end());
    cout << "unique去重后: ";
    for (int t : uv) cout << t << " ";  // 1 2 3 4 5
    cout << endl;

    // is_sorted 判断是否已排序
    vector<int> sv = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
    cout << "是否已排序: " << is_sorted(sv.begin(), sv.end()) << endl;

    return 0;
}
